fusions.name: Clean Leverage
fusions.desc: A drilled hip-and-shoulder blow that deals 18 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Whole-Body Stamp
fusions.desc: After a 1 second wind-up to set your feet, you stamp down and deal 34 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Full Extension
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Perfect Contact
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
